To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
deep neural networks are effective for attack detection in social internet of Things.
deep learning is a promising mechanism in cybersecurity, particularly in the detection of cyber attacks.

the deep learning model can be used to detect distributed denial of service (DDoS) and distributed reflection denial of service (DRDoS) attacks in social Internet of Things (SIoT) networks, which are more effective than the shallow models, and the distributed attack detection system outperforms the centralized detection system using deep learning model in SIoT networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a distributed attack detection scheme using a deep learning architecture.
the development of an attack detection system using deep learning approach to enable the detection and prevention of distributed attacks in social IoT.
developing a distributed attack detection scheme for IoT using deep learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our deep model is a better choice than shallow models for attack detection.
the deep learning based distributed attack detection system outperforms the centralized attack detection system in terms of accuracy.
the deep learning model is more effective than traditional machine learning model in detecting cyber attacks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed deep model is more efficient than the shallow one in terms of attack detection and the proposed distributed system is more efficient than centralized system in terms of detection time.

the proposed system could be used to detect attacks from the social Internet of Things (SIoT) and the performance of the system could be further improved by the use of distributed detection mechanism.
deep learning based approach can be a promising solution in the detection of cyber attacks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the deep learning based distributed attack detection system can provide a resilient and effective mechanism to detect cyber attacks.
deep learning model can be used for distributed attack detection in social internet of thing and it can be used as a resilient mechanism to novel attacks.
deep learning approach is a promising approach for detecting attacks in the cyberspaces.
